senses.gloss:
गुह् 1. गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. गूहति, -ते, जुगूह,
जुगुहे, गूहिष्यति or घोक्ष्यति, -ते,
अगूहीत्, अघुक्षत्, अगूढ, अघुक्षत, अगू-
हिषि, अघुक्षि, गूहितुम् or गोढुम्, to cover,
conceal, hide, hide away, keep secret; to cover with
clothes: Caus. गूहयति, -यितुम्, अजूगुहत्: Desid.
जुघुक्षति, -ते, to wish to conceal or hide away:
Intens. जोगुह्यते, जोगुहीति or जोगोढि.
2. गुह्, घुट्, f., Ved. a hiding-place.

गुह, अस्, m. a N. of Skanda or Kārttikeya, the
god of war (as reared in a secret place); an epithet
of Śiva; of Viṣṇu; N. of a king of the Niṣādas, a
friend of Rāma; a N. or title proper to persons of
the writer-caste; a horse, a swift horse; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of a people in the south of India.
—गुह-गुप्त,
अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—गुह-चन्द्र, अस्,
m., N. of a merchant.
—गुह-देव, अस्, m., N. of
a teacher.
—गुह-राज, अस्, m. a peculiar form or
construction of a temple.
—गुह-शिव, अस्, m., N.
of a king of Kaliṅga.
—गुह-षष्ठी, f. the sixth
day in the former half of Mārgaśīrṣa.
—गुह-सेन,
अस्, m., N. of a merchant.

गुहा, f. a cave, a cavern, a hiding-place; a
pit, a hole in the ground; the plant Hemionitis
Cordifolia; another plant, = शाल-पर्णी; (आ), ind. in
a hiding-place, in secret, secretly (opposed to आविस्).
गुहा धा or गुहा निधा or गुहा कृ, Ved. to
conceal, remove.
—गुहा-गृह, अम्, n. a cavern.
—गुहा-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, going in secret or secretly,
going in the interior.
—गुहा-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्,
wide-mouthed, open-mouthed.
—गुहा-शय, अस्, आ or
ई, अम्, lying in a secret place, being in the interior or
in the heart; living in hiding-places or in caverns;
(अस्), m. a tiger; an epithet of Viṣṇu.
—गुहा-
हित, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a secret or hidden place,
placed in the heart.

गुहद्-अवद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. concealing or
removing deficiencies.
गुहलु, उस्, m., N. of a man.
गुहिन, अम्, n. a wood, a thicket.

गुहिल, अम्, n. wealth, property; a wood (?);
(अस्), m., N. of a prince.
गुहेर, अस्, m. a guardian, a protector; a smith.
गुहेर गुहेर. See under rt. 1. गुह् last col.

गुह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be covered or concealed, to
be hidden, to be kept hidden or secret, concealable,
private; secret, solitary, retired; mysterious, mysti-
cal; (अम्), ind. secretly, privately; (अस्), m. hypo-
crisy; a tortoise; an epithet of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. a
secret, a mystery; a privity, an organ of generation,
&c.; the anus.
—गुह्य-काली, f. ‘the mysterious
Durgā,’ title of a poem in honour of this deity.
—गुह्य-गुरु, उस्, m. the mysterious Guru, an
epithet of Śiva, this deity being considered as the
especial teacher of the Tantras or Hindū mystical
and magical works; [cf. गृह्य-गुरु.]
—गुह्य-
तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra.
—गुह्य-दीपक,
अस्, m. a flying insect which gives out light; the fire-
fly.
—गुह्य-निष्यन्द, अस्, m. urine.
—गुह्य-
पति, इस्, m. lord of the mysteries, an epithet of
Vajra-dhara.
—गुह्य-पिधान, अम्, n. a covering
over the privities.
—गुह्य-पुष्प, अस्, m. the tree
with concealed blossoms, Ficus Religiosa; [cf. अश्वत्-
थ.]
—गुह्य-भाषित, अम्, n. secret speech, a
Mantra, a mystical prayer or incantation; a secret.
—गुह्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, containing mysteries.
—गुह्य-वीज, अस्, m. a kind of grass, = भू-तृण.
—गुह्येश्वरी (˚य-ईश्˚), f. the mysterious deity,
i. e. Prajñā, the female energy of the Ādi-buddha.

गुह्यक, अस्, m. a N. of a class of demi-gods who
like the Yakṣas are attendants of Kuvera or the god
of wealth, and guardians of his treasures; they may
have received their name from living in mountain
caverns.
—गुह्यकाधिपति (˚क-अध्˚), इस्, m. or
गुह्यकाधिप, अस्, m. or गुह्यकेश्वर (˚क-ईश्˚),
अस्, m. an epithet of Kuvera, the deity of wealth.
गूहन गूहन, &c. See under rt. गुह्.
गूहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, hiding, concealing.

गूहयित्वा, ind. having concealed, having hidden
or disguised.

गूहितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be hidden or concealed,
to be kept secret.
